title: Dispersion-corrected compact finite difference discretizations for the elastic Helmholtz equation in two and three dimensions
summary: We develop a family of compact, dispersion-corrected marker-and-cell (MAC)-based finite-difference discretizations for the elastic Helmholtz equation. While dispersion correction is well established for scalar Helmholtz problems, fewer approaches exist for the elastic problems, and most use non-compact stencils. To this end, we introduce a generalized MAC (GMAC) framework that enables compact discretization of the elastic Helmholtz equation.
